headline: EasyEquities says a security incident hit some of its systems; clients have been locked out since Nov 26 and the platform is still offline.
summary: New incident page. EasyEquities' help page (s001, last updated Nov 27) says it became aware of a security incident affecting some of its systems, is investigating with independent specialists, has restricted client login and some services and is keeping the platform offline; it is assessing whether personal information was accessed; it says all client funds are accounted for; trades go through its trading desk and some withdrawals may be delayed; the incident is not related to its brand refresh. TechCentral (s002) quotes the client email and the company's update that it is not related to the September provider breach; EWN (s003) reports the platform kept offline and calls it a second apparent cyberattack. September breach from EasyEquities' own page (s004); company facts from Purple Group (s005). Main answer Not established, filed under unclear: the company has not said that anyone got in. incident_type outage; service down on c002. Size Large. No photograph of EasyEquities or its offices found on Wikimedia Commons, so the picture is a screenshot of its notice (no contact details in the crop). Moneyweb, MyBroadband and Daily Investor refused access and were not used. Theory sweep: no Hacker News thread; Reddit could not be read. Privacy check done: no staff, reporters or contact details named.
